decision_conditions:
Thank you for your application.

As outlined in the application form, and noting that the trees are protected by a Tree Preservation Order (TPO), the Council requires further information in order to assess the proposal. Specifically, please provide:

The anticipated final height and spread (in metres) of the trees following the proposed works; and
A clear arboricultural justification for carrying out the works.

This information is necessary to determine the impact of the proposed works on the amenity value and long-term health of the protected trees.
Please provide the above details at your earliest convenience so that your application can be progressed.
